equations.expression: B_r = -(1/r) partial_z psi; B_z = (1/r) partial_r psi
equations.axis_limit: psi=a(z) r^2+O(r^4), hence B_r(0,z)=0 and B_z(0,z)=2a(z)

equations.expression: partial_rr psi - r^-1 partial_r psi + partial_zz psi = -mu r J_phi
equations.derivation: curl B = mu J with (curl B)_phi=partial_z B_r-partial_r B_z=mu J_phi
equations.sign_check: substitution of B_r and B_z gives -(1/r)(psi_rr-r^-1 psi_r+psi_zz)=mu J_phi

equations.weak_energy: integral (1/r)|grad psi|^2 dr dz is positive for zero Dirichlet boundary

equations.boundary: psi=0 on r=0, r=R, z=z0, z=z0+L

source_convention.band: rectangular meridional cross-section carrying azimuthal J_phi
source_convention.support_domain: every band must lie within r=[dr/2,R-dr/2], z=[z_min+dz/2,z_max-dz/2] and span at least two grid spacings in each direction
source_convention.minimum_width_comparison: width >= 2*spacing minus the summed half-ULP uncertainty of lower endpoint, upper endpoint, and represented target; an exact decimal-looking two-cell span passes while the next meaningfully narrower binary64 endpoint fails
source_convention.grid_transfer: nodal J_phi is the interior dual-cell overlap average using physical band area; sum(J_phi dr dz) preserves signed requested ampere-turns without compressing omitted boundary volume
source_convention.reported_transfer_error: requested/represented area and ampere-turns, their errors, requested/represented centroids, centroid errors, and touched radial/axial/dual-cell counts (the represented resolution) are published per band
source_convention.interpretation: smeared equivalent coil/current-sheet source; not a permanent magnet
source_convention.polarity: +1 means positive e_phi current in the selected cylindrical convention

boundary_conditions.axis: essential psi(0,z)=0 plus recovered even regular expansion
boundary_conditions.outer_box: psi=0 at r=R and both axial truncation planes
boundary_conditions.warning: finite-box homogeneous Dirichlet is a truncation approximation, not an exact open boundary

discretization.operator: face-centred 1/r radial flux and node-centred 1/r axial flux
discretization.status_contract: publish converged only when a separately recomputed true algebraic residual meets max(atol,rtol*initial); a false recursive crossing restarts PCG from the true residual within remaining iterations, with bounded restart/stagnation diagnostics
discretization.field_recovery: centred second-order differences; regularized fourth-order-compatible axis coefficient from psi(dr),psi(2dr)
discretization.flux_reconstruction_identity: reported cylindrical mixed-derivative identity of Br/Bz reconstructed from the same psi; useful for reconstruction consistency but not independent solution validation

artifact_contract.canonicalization: one recursive field-artifact normalizer followed by compact or pretty UTF-8 sorted-key JSON; every floating signed zero becomes +0.0 while finite nonzero binary64 values are preserved exactly
artifact_contract.payload_integrity: top-level integrity is excluded from its own SHA-256 payload, avoiding recursion
artifact_contract.file_integrity: raw file SHA-256 is stored in a filename-bound .sha256 sidecar; manifest entries anchor both artifact file and payload hashes
artifact_contract.topology_policy: fields with |B|max <= 1e-14 T are degenerate and publish no isolated nulls; nondegenerate axis candidates are classified as sign-changing, isolated, or near-zero plateaus
artifact_contract.validation_error: all strict parser failures use FieldArtifactValidationError, a FieldValidationError and ValueError subclass; huge JSON integer/binary64 conversion overflow is wrapped and never escapes as OverflowError

warp_fem_decision.finding: Warp FEM provides scalar diffusion forms and a 3D H(curl) magnetostatics example, but no inspected example verifies the singular axisymmetric 1/r weighted form and axis trace.
warp_fem_decision.decision: Use the auditable structured-grid matrix-free FDM for L1a and do not label it FEM. Retain Warp for real CPU/CUDA matrix-free kernels.

required_before_l1_production: derive and validate equivalent magnetization/surface-current mapping for each physical magnet
represent material interfaces and measured or sourced permeability
solve nonlinear iron B-H curves with continuation and convergence checks
replace finite-box truncation with verified open/infinite boundary treatment
perform geometry-aware mesh refinement and quantity-of-interest convergence
obtain FEMM full-profile parity across benchmark geometries
preferably obtain independent MFEM axisymmetric or revolved-3D comparison
validate against measured field maps with uncertainty
